title: xz decompress
summary: Decompress .xz streams (LZMA2, recorded at every preset from 1 to 9 with CRC64 and CRC32 checks, over text and binary data, two of them several blocks long) and return the original bytes.
notes: One operation decompresses one in-memory .xz stream and returns the decompressed bytes, compared exactly with the original. The streams were recorded once by the xz 5.8.4 command (liblzma), single-stream, LZMA2 only, each with a dictionary just large enough for its input, so every entry decodes the same bytes; nothing is compressed in the timed call.
